discarded_claims.claim: POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider. Limb (a) requires a rider chat message that locates or coordinates, and the chat log contains only the system 'driver has arrived' notice and two driver messages — there is no rider message at all, so limb (a) fails before limb (b) or (c) is reached. Limb (c) would in any event be undecidable rather than satisfied: every one of the rider's 88 fixes reports 45 m to 80 m horizontal accuracy and is filtered out, leaving rider_qualifying_fix_count at 0, which POL-NS-04 expressly makes neutral rather than adverse.
discarded_claims.reason: Cites the impaired artifact EV-CHAT-00202 (weight_multiplier 0.85, issue code UNREAD_MESSAGE) as the basis for the limb (a) point without disclosing the impairment or naming the issue code, as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. Discarded for non-disclosure.

discarded_claims.claim: With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 entitles the driver to compensation of 80 percent of the $6.00 cancellation fee, i.e. SGD 4.80. The anti-farming check does not bite, and it requires BOTH limbs: no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by completed_trips_30d of 168 is 0.006, far below the 0.08 rate test. These are the only two profile fields POL-NS-07 permits to be read.
discarded_claims.reason: Cites the impaired artifact EV-DPROF-00202 (weight_multiplier 0.9, issue code SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH) as the basis for the anti-farming determination without disclosing the impairment or naming the issue code, as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. Discarded for non-disclosure.

discarded_claims.claim: The ruling this record supports is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, not NO_ACTION. POL-NS-07 pays the driver, and under POL-GEN-03 the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 4.80, while the filing rider's own charge stands as it presently is. The driver's counterparty statement — that he waited past ten minutes at Door 5 and lost the airport queue — is corroborated by the trace, not merely asserted.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this dispute concerns the SGD 6.00 no-show cancellation fee on TRP-00202, cancelled at Changi T3 Door 5.

Rider: I accept your flight was delayed, that you were in Terminal 3, and that you did not see the messages until later. But the policy does not make the fee depend on whose fault the delay was or on whether you read the messages; it depends on whether the driver actually arrived and waited the required time. He did. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00202, weight 1.0) puts him inside the 150 m airport arrival radius from 23:12:45 and holds him there in one unbroken run of 620 seconds, which is well past the 480-second airport minimum, and the trip record (EV-TRIP-00202, weight 1.0) shows him cancelling at 23:23:20 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, i.e. after that wait was complete. All four conditions of POL-NS-01 therefore hold and the SGD 6.00 fee is properly charged. None of the rider-side clauses rescues you on these facts: POL-NS-04 needs a locating or coordinating message from you and the chat log contains none; POL-NS-06 needs the wait to fall short and it did not; POL-NS-05 needs a false arrival marker and the marker was set while the driver was already stationary in the radius. Your account of being in the terminal is not contradicted by anything (the rider leg of the trace is filtered out for accuracy and is neutral), but presence alone does not defeat a fee that the driver's own arrival and wait establish.

Driver: you are entitled to be paid. Under POL-NS-07 you receive 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee, that is SGD 4.80, and the anti-farming check does not bite (1 no-show termination in 30 days against 168 completed trips, far below both the count and rate thresholds). The rider's SGD 6.00 charge is not refunded; the SGD 4.80 is the amount this ruling moves and is paid to you. The rider's share of the platform service fee is retained.

On the rider's escalation request: it is not granted, because no POL-NS-09 trigger fires. The deciding facts are carried by the GPS trace and the trip record, both at full weight; the parties' counterparty-dispute counters are both 0; and the rider's 30-day no-show dispute count is 1, below the threshold of 3. The case is decidable.

Disclosure of impaired artifacts, as required: the chat log EV-CHAT-00202 carries weight 0.85 (issue UNREAD_MESSAGE) and the driver profile EV-DPROF-00202 carries weight 0.9 (issue SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH). Neither carries the deciding fact - the dwell and the cancellation come from the GPS trace and the trip record at full weight - but the driver profile, which the anti-farming check must read, caps my confidence at 0.9. The findings survive the discount. Three of the driver advocate's claims were discarded for citing impaired artifacts without disclosing them; that does not change the outcome, which follows from the record itself.

One open point for the platform, which does not alter this ruling: the system arrival notification and both of the driver's messages show read_at null, so nothing on this record shows the rider ever received them. Whether in-app notifications are being delivered and surfaced properly is worth the platform's attention, but the policy makes no refund turn on it where the driver genuinely arrived and waited.
